Fahriyah is also associated with the Arabic word 'faher,' meaning 'to be blessed with good fortune.' In Islamic tradition, Fahriyah is a name that signifies Allah's favor and blessings upon a person. It is a name that represents happiness, prosperity, and good fortune, and is considered a blessed name in many Muslim cultures.
